card.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
card.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stop resetting the light. Ask the house whether it wants darkness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need light to work. It's just faulty wiring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask it to light only your desk, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only my desk came on. I'll still call an electrician.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cancel that. Ask the house about overtime; we need its agreement before booking your evening shifts.

mechanism: A pushes B to abandon electrical repair and negotiate exclusively with a supposedly willing house.
confusable: Unlike merely offering an unusual hypothesis, A must reject B's retained ordinary fallback and govern further action by the strange one.
comparison: A selective light response becomes a house-labor agreement, while the keys scene rejects physical searching for emotional negotiation.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
